resources.string: A song link from Apple Music, Spotify or Deezer opens in Violence and plays that song. Links you share into Violence from another app always work, whatever this is set to.
Android only opens a link in an app you have approved for it. Open the page, choose Add link, and tick the music sites. A site is grey while another app owns it: see below.
Allowed for %1$d of %2$d addresses. Tap to change.
Android gives %1$s its links first, and keeps their boxes grey. Open its link settings, turn off Open supported links, then tick them under Allow these links.
Violence opens songs and albums from %1$s links, not playlists or artists yet
